name: Ilmi Blomberg
original_name: イルミ ブロムベルグ
source:
A famous immortal vampire and a natural airhead. She's a bit of a masochist and regularly gets nosebleeds when getting too excited.  

She met [url=/c12622]Kazuto[/url] 10 years ago and now they finally reunite...
